y-m-57-03.title: Area yegadheni yemidziyo kana urefu hwefence hwakagadziriswa
y-m-57-03.topic: Maximum ye quadratic function nerenji rinobvumirwa re variable
y-m-57-03.goal: Tarisa netafura kuti maximum ye area yakanyorwa se quadratic expression inoitika kupi, tonga iwe pachako kuti nzvimbo ye maximum inogona kuchinja kana mamiriro matsva achichinja renji re variable, uye ugadzire mhinduro mukati merenji iwe pachako.
y-m-57-03.material: Unoda kugadzira gadheni yemidziyo ine chimiro che rectangle uchishandisa divi rimwe rekamuzinda. Hapana fence inoiswa padivi rekamuzinda, uye unoshandisa 20 m yose ye fence kumativi matatu asara. Kana mativi maviri ari perpendicular kukamuzinda ega ega ane urefu x m, saka divi rakafanana nekamuzinda ndi (20−2x) m. Saka area yegadheni ndi x(20−2x) m², uye pano 0<x<10.
y-m-57-03.thinking.0: Fanofungidzira kuti maximum iri kupi uchishandisa tafura
y-m-57-03.thinking.1: Chinja kutonga kwako nekuratidza kuti mamiriro matsva anochinja sei renji re variable
y-m-57-03.thinking.2: Tsvaga makosha anogutsa mamiriro maviri panguva imwe chete
y-m-57-03.prereq.1: Kuisa makosha mu expression ine letter nekuverenga
y-m-57-03.s.s1.prompt: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, tarisa ruzivo rutsva uye usarudze kutonga kwako nezve x inoita kuti area ive hombe zvakanyanya.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.hint.0: Isa x se 1, 2, 3, ... imwe imwe uye uverenge area.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora mamiriro matsva se inequality mu x uye tanga watara renji rinogoneka re x.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Sezvo x ichikura, mativi ari perpendicular kukamuzinda anorefuka, asi divi rakafanana nekamuzinda, (20−2x), rinopfupika. Hausati waverenga makosha chero api.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Area inochinja sei sezvaunoita x yakakura kubva ku0 kuenda ku10?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana divi rimwe rarefuka, rimwe rinopfupika, saka haugoni kutonga kubva pachiitiko chedivi rimwe oga. 'b' ndiko kufanofungidzira uye 'd' ndiko kutonga kunofanira kutariswa netafura. Ngatitarisei netafura.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Inokura pakutanga, wozodzikira kubva papoinzi imwe
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uchitarisa tafura, ungatonga sei nezve x inopa area hombe zvakanyanya?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Tafura ine makosha akaenzana kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe5 (4 ne6 dzinopa 48, 3 ne7 dzinopa 42). Saka 5 ndiyo musarudzwa mukuru. Kana ukanyora zvakare expression se −2(x−5)²+50, unogona kusimbisa kuti kunyange kune decimal x, 50 pa5 ndiyo maximum.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ndinotonga kuti inova hombe zvakanyanya kana x=5 (pakati pemakosha e integer ari mutafura, 5 ndiyo maximum zvakare)
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ndinotonga kuti inova hombe zvakanyanya kana x=4
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ndinotonga kuti inova hombe zvakanyanya kana x=6
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Iri padhuze ne x=5, asi zvakamuka kutaura nechokwadi tisati tatarisa makosha e decimal
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Ruzivo rutsva: kamuzinda umo muchaiswa gadheni iri ndi8 m chete kureba. Divi rakafanana nekamuzinda, (20−2x), haringagone kuva rakawanda kupfuura 8 m.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zvino, pakati pe x dzinogoneka, ungatonga sei kukosha kunopa area hombe zvakanyanya?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kubva ku 20−2x≤8, x inofanira kuva 6 kana kupfuura. Kana x=5, divi rakafanana ndi10 m, rakareba kupfuura kamuzinda, saka hazvigoneki. Kune x≥6, x ichikura, area inodzikira, saka 48 pa x=6 ndiyo maximum. Vertex ye expression (x=5) inogona kuva kunze kwerenji rinogoneka.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.reflect: Kana mamiriro matsva aonekwa, hazvisi kuti kutonga kwako kwekare (x=5) kwakashata; 'renji rinogoneka re x' rakachinja, saka nzvimbo ye maximum inogona kuchinja. Taura kuti ruzivo rupi rwakachinja kutonga kwako, kana kuti waigona kuchengeta sezvakaita.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.prompt: Pasi pemamiriro ekuti kamuzinda ndi8 m, tsvaga makosha 3 akasiyana e x apo area iri 46 m² kana kupfuura. (x inogona kuva decimal.)
y-m-57-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza renji re x kubva pamamiriro ekamuzinda, uye uedze makosha mukati maro chete.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga area pa x=6, wozowedzera x zvishoma nezvishoma uye uone kuti area inochinja sei.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.ok.c1: x yakakura kupfuura 0 uye diki kupfuura 10.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.fail.c1: x inofanira kuva hombe kupfuura 0 uye diki kupfuura 10.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Divi rakafanana nekamuzinda ndi8 m kana pasi.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Divi rakafanana nekamuzinda, (20−2x), rakawanda kupfuura 8 m.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.explain: Kubva pamamiriro ekamuzinda, x≥6, uye kubva pamamiriro e area x(20−2x)≥46, x inenge 6.41 kana pasi. Saka makosha mukati me 6≤x≤6.41 ndiwo mhinduro. Kune x=6.5 area ndi45.5, isina kukwana.

y-m-57-01.title: Correspondences ina: ndedzipi ma functions?
y-m-57-01.topic: Zvinoreva function: correspondence ine mhedzisiro imwe pa input imwe neimwe
y-m-57-01.goal: Tonga ma correspondences nechiyero che 'mhedzisiro imwe pa input imwe neimwe', ratidza nemienzaniso yawunogadzira kuti ma inputs akasiyana anogona kuva nemhedzisiro imwechete uye achiri function, uye utaure kuti ungagadzirisa sei correspondence isiri function kuti ive function.
y-m-57-01.material:
Kana pane correspondence (mutemo), tinoda kutarisa kuti mhedzisiro ipi inobuda pa input imwe. Pane ma correspondences mana pazasi.
(가) Kumudzidzi wese mukirasi, pa nhamba yekuuya yemudzidzi iyoyo. (Nhamba dzekuuya dzatogadziriswa.)
(나) Kune positive integer x, pa ma positive divisors e x.
(다) Kune integer x, pa square ye x.
(라) Kune real number x i 0 kana kupfuura, pa "real number y ine square inoenzana ne x."
y-m-57-01.thinking.0: Nyora mhedzisiro dzese pa input imwe neimwe pasi pemutemo we correspondence uye utonge
y-m-57-01.thinking.1: Gadzira function apo ma inputs akasiyana ane mhedzisiro imwechete
y-m-57-01.thinking.2: Gadzirisa correspondence isiri function nekuchinja mamiriro ayo kuti ive function
y-m-57-01.prereq.0: H2 inoratidza danho rekunetsa nerekutsigira reseti iyi yekugadzira chete; hairi kugoverwa kwegiredhi rechikoro. Fungidzira kuti zvirimo zvepadanho re middle school pazasi zvatodzidzwa.
y-m-57-01.prereq.1: Zvinoreva element yeseti neshoko rekuti correspondence (padanho re middle school)
y-m-57-01.prereq.2: Kuisa mutengo mu expression kuwana mhedzisiro
y-m-57-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza ma correspondences ese ari ma functions. (Function: correspondence apo, pa input value imwe neimwe inogoneka, mhedzisiro inosarudzwa kuva imwe chaizvo.)
y-m-57-01.s.s1.hint.0: Pa correspondence imwe neimwe, sarudza input imwe uye unyore mhedzisiro dzese dzinobuda.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.hint.1: Pa correspondence imwe neimwe, sarudza ma inputs maviri kana matatu uye uite tebhura re "input → mhedzisiro", wobva watsvaga mitsetse apo ma inputs akafanana kana mhedzisiro dzakafanana.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kwakaverenga, imwe neimwe, kuti input imwe neimwe (mudzidzi) ine mhedzisiro (nhamba) dzingani.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.o.b: (나) positive integer x → ma positive divisors e x
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.b: Verenga kuti mhedzisiro dzingani dzinobuda kune input 6. Chiyero i kana pane kunyange input imwe ine mhedzisiro dzakawanda.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kwakaparadzanisa kana ma inputs akasiyana (semuenzaniso 2 ne −2) abvumirwa kuva nemhedzisiro imwechete kubva pachiyero chekuti input imwe neimwe ine mhedzisiro dzingani.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.o.d: (라) real number x i 0 kana kupfuura → y ine square i x
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.d: Kune input 4, nyora ma real numbers y ese ane square i 4. Chiyero i kuverenga kuti pane mangani.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.explain: Chiyero che function i 'input imwe inopa mhedzisiro imwe chete here'. (가) i function nekuti mudzidzi wese ane nhamba imwe, uye (다) i function nekuti integer imwe neimwe ine square imwe. Zvakanaka kuti 2 ne −2 zvose zvipe 4 mu (다). (나) haisi function nekuti 6 inopa 1, 2, 3, 6, uye (라) haisi function nekuti 4 inopa 2 ne −2.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.prompt: Funga function f ine domain {1, 2, 3} ne codomain {1, 2, 3, 4}. Gadzira ma functions 3 akasiyana ane range ine ma elements 2 chaizvo. (p = f(1), q = f(2), r = f(3))
y-m-57-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti mapeya mangani pakati pemitengo mitatu f(1), f(2), f(3) anofanira kuenzana kuti uwane marudzi maviri emitengo.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wasarudza ma inputs maviri anova nemutengo mumwechete, uye upe input yasara mutengo wakasiyana.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Mitengo yese mitatu i mukati me codomain {1, 2, 3, 4}.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.fail.c1: f(1), f(2), f(3) imwe neimwe inofanira kuva imwe ye 1, 2, 3, 4.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Unogona kushandisa ma elements e codomain chete. Ma decimals haasi mu codomain.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Huwandu hwemitengo yakasiyana yakabuda i 2 chaizvo.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Hapana mitengo 2 yakasiyana. Tarisa kuti mitengo mitatu haisi yese yakafanana kana yese yakasiyana.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.explain: Range ine ma elements 2 inoreva kuti ma inputs maviri pa matatu ane mhedzisiro imwechete. Semuenzaniso, f(1)=f(2)=1, f(3)=2 i function zvakare. Pane ma functions 36 akadaro dzose. Function inogona kuva nema inputs akasiyana ane mhedzisiro imwechete, asi input imwe ine mhedzisiro imwe chete.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.prompt: Ungagadzirisa sei mutemo we correspondence (라) kuti ive function? Nyora mutemo wakagadziriswa nechikonzero chekuti kuugadzirisa nenzira iyoyo kunoshanda.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora ma y ese anogutsa mamiriro kana x=4.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti ungawedzera mamiriro api kuti uchengete mutengo mumwe chete pamitengo iyoyo.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mumutemo wako wakagadziriswa, wakatarisa iwe pachako here kuti input senge 4 inopa mhedzisiro imwe chete?
y-m-57-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: 'Chikonzero' chakabatanidzwa here nehuwandu hwemakosha akaenderana ne4?
y-m-57-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga here kuti nzira yakasiyana neyako (semuenzaniso, kubvumira 0 kana pasi chete) inogonekawo?
y-m-57-01.s.s3.model.0: Ndinogadzirisa kuti y ye0 kana kupfuura chete ndiyo inoenderanwa (square root). Pakutanga, kana x=4, y yaiva nemakosha maviri, 2 ne−2, asi kana ndikaidzora kuva 0 kana kupfuura, mhedzisiro imwe chete ndiyo inosara.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.model.1: Ndinobvumira makosha e y asiri negative chete kuti input imwe neimwe ive nemhedzisiro imwe. Dambudziko raiva rekuti 2 ne−2 zvose zvakabuda pa x=4.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro yemuenzaniso inotaura nzira yekudzora renji nenzira yakasiyana

y-m-57-02.title: Kuongorora chirevo chekuti 'kana yakakwirira, slope yakakura'
y-m-57-02.topic: Slope ye linear function: chiratidzo nekukwirira
y-m-57-02.goal: Ziva kuti 'yakakwirira' ne 'slope yakakura' hazvigari zvichireva chinhu chimwe chete, tsvaga uye ugadzirise mutsara wakashata mumamiriro apo ma slopes ane zviratidzo zvakasiyana anoenzaniswa, uye ugadzire muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-57-02.material: Ma graphs e linear functions maviri y=2x ne y=−3x akadhirowwa pa coordinate plane imwe chete. Graph ye y=2x inokwira kurudyi, uye graph ye y=−3x inodzika kurudyi. Slope ndiko 'kuchinja kwe y kana x ichiwedzera ne1'. Pazasi pane chikamu umo mudzidzi akaenzanisa ma slopes maviri.
y-m-57-02.thinking.0: Tsvaga kukanganisa nekuparadzanisa mitsara yemhinduro kuita zvokwadi nekupfuvura
y-m-57-02.thinking.1: Gadzira iwe pachako muenzaniso unopikisa apo kupfuvura kunoputsika
y-m-57-02.prereq.1: Zvinoreva kuti mu linear function y=ax+b, kuchinja kwe y kana x ichiwedzera ne1 ndiyo slope a
y-m-57-02.prereq.2: Kuenzanisa saizi ye positive ne negative numbers pa number line
y-m-57-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga muchikamu ichi une chirevo chakashata. (Mitsara inotevera chirevo ichocho inogonawo kuva yakashata.)
y-m-57-02.s.s1.hint.0: Rongedza mutsara mumwe nemumwe kuita 'zvokwadi zvakaverengwa kubva pa graph kana equation' kana 'chirevo chakaitwa kubva pamutemo'.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.hint.1: Isa −3 ne2 pa number line uye uenzanise kuti ndeipi iri kure kurudyi nekukwirira kwe graph imwe neimwe.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.0: Kune y=2x, kana x ichiwedzera ne1, y inowedzera ne2.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.1: Kune y=−3x, kana x ichiwedzera ne1, y inodzikira ne3.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.2: Graph iri yakakwirira ine slope yakakura.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.3: Graph ye y=−3x yakakwirira, saka slope ye y=−3x yakakura.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 1 ne2 zvokwadi zvakaverengwa kubva pa graph. Mutsara 3, 'iri yakakwirira ine slope yakakura', ndiko kupfuvura, uye hakushande. Kukwirira kunoenzanisa absolute values dze ma slopes (3 ne2), nepo saizi ye slope, kusanganisira chiratidzo, ichienzanisa −3 ne2. Mutsara 4 mhedzisiro chete yekushandisa mutsara 3, uye kune mutsara 5, −3 iri kuruboshwe kwe2 pa number line, saka −3<2.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira linear functions 3 dzakasiyana y=ax+b dzakakwirira kupfuura y=2x asi dzine slope diki. Y-intercept (b) inofanira kuva 1.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora zvakare 'yakakwirira' uchishandisa absolute value ye slope, uye utsvage renji pa number line rinogutsa pamwe chete ne 'slope idiki'.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kana wasarudza musarudzwa a, tarisa mamiriro maviri zvakaparadzana.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Yakakwirira kupfuura y=2x (absolute value ye slope yakakura kupfuura 2).
y-m-57-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukwirira kwe graph hakuna kukura kupfuura kwe y=2x.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.explain: Kuti ive yakakwirira, absolute value ye slope inofanira kuva hombe kupfuura 2, uye slope inofanira kuva pasi pe2, saka a inofanira kuva pasi pe −2. Mienzaniso: y=−3x+1, y=−5x+1, y=−2.5x+1. a=3 ine slope hombewo, saka haisi muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.prompt: Zvino nyora zvakaparadzana nyaya apo 'graph yakakwirira' ne 'slope yakakura' zvichireva chinhu chimwe chete nenyaya apo zvisingaiti.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa kurongeka kwekukwirira nekurongeka kwema slopes kana ma slopes ose ari positive, senge 2 ne5.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa nenzira imwe chete nyaya apo zvose zviri negative, senge −2 ne −5.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here nyaya apo zvinoreva chinhu chimwe chete nema slopes maviri chaiwo?
y-m-57-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza here imwe nyaya nemuenzaniso unopikisa wawakagadzira kare?
y-m-57-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakafungawo here nezve nyaya apo slope iri 0?
y-m-57-02.s.s3.model.0: Kana ma slopes ose ari positive, iri yakakwirira ine slope yakakura. Asi kana negative yakasanganiswa, kukwirira kunoenzaniswa neabsolute value, saka kunogona kusiyana nekuenzanisa saizi dze ma slopes.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.model.1: Kana zvose ari mitsara inokwira kurudyi, iri yakakwirira ine slope yakakura. Kana imwe iri mutsara unodzika, enzanisa kukwirira neabsolute value, uye enzanisa ma slopes uchitarisawo chiratidzo.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro yemuenzaniso yakanyorwa ichitarisa divi re negative

y-m-57-04.title: Kuziva kukwirira kwe ramp
y-m-57-04.topic: Trigonometric ratios: kufanana kwe right triangles neruzivo rwekureba
y-m-57-04.goal: Tonga kuti ruzivo rupi rwakakwana kutara kukwirira kwe right triangle sekukosha kumwe chete, uye usimbise nemienzaniso yawakagadzira iwe pachako kuti kana kona yakafanana, ma ratios emativi akafanana kunyange kureba kwakasiyana.
y-m-57-04.material: Unoda kuisa ramp yakatwasuka kubva pachivanze chakaenzana kuenda kumusuwo wechivako. Magumo epasi e ramp anobata pasi uye magumo epamusoro anobata pasi pemusuwo, uye musuwo uri pakukwirira kwakamira kwe h m pamusoro pepasi. (Pasi nepasi pemusuwo zvakaenzana, uye ramp, kukwirira kwakamira nemwero wakatwasuka pasi zvinoumba right triangle.) Pazasi pane seti dzeruzivo dzakanyorwa nemugadziri. 'Kona' yega yega ndi 'kona yakaitwa ne ramp nepasi', uye mubasa iri tinoshandisa sine (sin) 30° = 1/2 (= kukwirira ÷ hypotenuse).
y-m-57-04.thinking.1: Ziva kuti kona oga haitari saizi
y-m-57-04.thinking.2: Gadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso ye similar right triangles
y-m-57-04.prereq.1: Kunzwisisa pa middle-school level hukama pakati pemativi e right triangle
y-m-57-04.prereq.2: Zvinoreva kuti ma ratios emativi anoenderana e similar figures akaenzana
y-m-57-04.prereq.3: Nyaya yekuti sine ye 30° ndi 1/2 (yakapiwa mukati mebasa iri)
y-m-57-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza seti dzose idzo ruzivo irworwo oga runotara kukwirira kwemusuwo h sekukosha kumwe chete.
y-m-57-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kune seti imwe neimwe, verenga uye unyore huwandu 'hwemakosha anozikanwa' ne 'makosha asingazikanwi'.
y-m-57-04.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira ma right triangles maviri ane kona imwe chete asi saizi dzakasiyana, uye utarise kana seti ichisiyanisa ma triangles maviri.
y-m-57-04.s.s1.o.a: Urefu hwe ramp 10 m, mwero wakatwasuka we6 m kubva kumagumo epasi e ramp kuenda kuchivako
y-m-57-04.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunobvunza kana, kana mativi maviri e right triangle akapiwa, divi rasara rakatarwa sekukosha kumwe chete.
y-m-57-04.s.s1.o.b: Kona yakaitwa ne ramp nepasi ndi30°, kona yakaitwa ne ramp nerusvingo rwechivako ndi60°
y-m-57-04.s.s1.r.b: Sum yemakona maviri ndi90°, saka inotaura ruzivo rumwe chete kaviri. Pangava nema triangles akafanana ane saizi dzakasiyana akawanda sezvaunoda.
y-m-57-04.s.s1.o.c: Chokwadi chekuti urefu hwe ramp hwakareba ne4 m kupfuura mwero wakatwasuka

y-m-57-05.title: Nzvimbo dziri pamwero wakaenzana kubva kuma base stations maviri
y-m-57-05.topic: Coordinate plane: mapoinzi ari pamwero wakaenzana kubva kumapoinzi maviri
y-m-57-05.goal: Ziva kuti poinzi yepakati haisi iyo yega iri pamwero wakaenzana kubva kumapoinzi maviri, gadzira mapoinzi akadaro akawanda akasiyana, uye utsanangure kuti anoronga muchimiro chipi.
y-m-57-05.material: Pa coordinate plane (grid unit imwe ndi1 km) pane base stations A(1, 2) ne B(7, 10). Unoda kuisa antenna yenguva pfupi papoinzi P(x, y). Mwero pakati pemapoinzi (x₁, y₁) ne (x₂, y₂) ndi 'positive square root ye (x₁−x₂)²+(y₁−y₂)²'. Poinzi yepakati yemapoinzi maviri ndiyo poinzi ine x-coordinate ne y-coordinate zviri averages ema x-coordinates nema y-coordinates emapoinzi maviri. Poinzi yepakati yema base stations maviri A ne B ndi M(4, 6).
y-m-57-05.thinking.0: Ongorora kana mhinduro imwe inozivikanwa (poinzi yepakati) yakakwana
y-m-57-05.prereq.1: Kunyora nzvimbo yepoinzi se (x, y) pa coordinate plane
y-m-57-05.prereq.2: Zvinoreva mwero pakati pemapoinzi maviri nepoinzi yepakati (inotsanangurwa mukati mebasa iri)
y-m-57-05.s.s1.prompt: Pane mapoinzi P mangani ari padaro rakaenzana kubva kuA nekuB?
y-m-57-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kunze kwepakati M, sarudza macoordinates akawanda, uye uverenge uye uenzanise masquare emadaro kubva papoinzi iyoyo kuenda kuA nekuB.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzira mitaurire miviri yemasquare emadaro mu x ne y, uye uvaenzanise.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.r.a: Uku kutonga kwakatsvaga makandidate mamwe kunze kwepakati ndokuaedza.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.r.b: Zvechokwadi pakati ipoinzi yakadaro. Asi unofanira kuongorora kana iri yega. Enzanisa madaro maviri epoinzi yakafambiswa zvishoma kuenda kudivi kubva pakati.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.r.c: Macoordinates eA neB akapiwa, saka unogona kuverenga uye kuenzanisa madaro. Unogona kuedza zvakananga kana poinzi ichiita mamiriro.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.r.d: Kana wakafunga mapoinzi maviri umo madenderedzwa maviri ane maradius akagadzikwa anosangana, iyo inyaya umo kukosha kwedaro kwakagadzikwa. Pano madaro maviri anongoda kuenzana pakati pawo, uye kukosha ikoko hakuna kugadzikwa.
y-m-57-05.s.s1.explain: Pakati M(4, 6) inoita PA=PB, asi pane mamwe mapoinzi. Semuenzaniso, (8, 3) ine square yedaro kuA yakaenzana ne7²+1²=50 uye kuB yakaenzana ne1²+7²=50, saka akaenzana. Pane mapoinzi akawanda zvisingaperi akadai pamutsetse.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.prompt: Wana mapoinzi 3 akasiyana P(x, y) anoita PA=PB. Siya pakati M, uye P inofanira kuva muquadrant yekutanga (x>0, y>0). (Madhesimali anoshanda.)
y-m-57-05.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza x, wobva wagadzirisa kuti y inofanira kuva chii kuti masquare emadaro maviri aenzane.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isa mapoinzi awakawana padivi nedivi uye uenzanise kuti y inochinja zvakadini kana x ichichinja.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.fail.c1: x ne y zvinofanira kuva zvakakura kupfuura 0 zvose.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Wakatoziva pakati M. Wana imwe poinzi.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.explain: Kana PA=PB, kuwanza mativi ose maviri kaviri kunopa 3x+4y=36. Mapoinzi ose emutsetse uyu ari muquadrant yekutanga mhinduro. Mienzaniso: (8, 3), (2, 7.5), (6, 4.5). Mutsetse uyu unopfuura nepakati M(4, 6) uye uri perpendicular neAB.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora kuti unofunga mapoinzi awakawana aizogadzira chimiro chipi kana akaiswa pacoordinate plane, nechikonzero chekufunga kwako.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isa mapoinzi matatu awakawana pacoordinate plane zvisinganyatsori, uye ufungidzire chimiro chavanoenderana nacho.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa kana pakati M iri pamutsetse mumwe nemapoinzi iwayo.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakasarudza mapoinzi maviri pakati pawakawana ukaongorora kana machiyero akafanana here?
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakaongorora kana pakati iri pamutsetse mumwe here?
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakafungawo here nemukana wakasiyana wechimiro chedenderedzwa?
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Ndinofunga zvose zviri pamutsetse mumwe. Mutsetse unopfuura nepakati uye uri perpendicular neAB, uye unogona kuona mutemo wekuti kana x ichiwedzera, y inodzika nemwero wakagara.
y-m-57-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Mapoinzi anoenderana nemutsetse wakananga. Sa (8, 3), (6, 4.5), (2, 7.5), kana x ichidzika ne2, y inokwira ne1.5, uye inopfuura nepakati.
